description: Install Flutter SDK in the sandbox environment and create a working branch for the upgrade work.
steps: Download Flutter SDK stable channel (latest 3.x) and extract to a suitable location (e.g., /opt/flutter or /home/user/flutter)
Add Flutter to PATH so 'flutter' command works
Create a new git branch named 'fix/flutter-upgrade' from the current HEAD in /projects/sandbox/Trovami
Run 'flutter pub get' to see the current state of dependency resolution (it will likely fail, which is expected - just confirm Flutter itself works)
acceptance_criteria: A git branch 'fix/flutter-upgrade' exists and is checked out
verification: Run 'flutter --version' and confirm output shows Flutter 3.x
Run 'git branch --show-current' in /projects/sandbox/Trovami and confirm it shows 'fix/flutter-upgrade'
